# DESIGN:OS CLI (ease-design)

> FREE design CLI for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity: describe the interface in plain words, get production-grade UI back, gated by code. Source-available (PolyForm Shield).

A multi-runtime design CLI driven from Claude Code, Codex CLI or Antigravity with `/ui:*` commands. One design system; web, Figma and Apple-native execution. The deterministic UI kernel routes, validates contracts, and refuses unqualified claims without calling external models. Figma is an output target (compatibility), not part of the product name.

License: source-available (PolyForm Shield 1.0.0). The product is FREE and is not sold. The license is source-available (PolyForm Shield 1.0.0), not MIT.

Author: Jang Trịnh, a creative technologist and autonomous system architect. https://www.jang.work/

Updated: 20 November 2026 (Asia/Saigon).

## Install once

```bash
npm i -g ease-design
ui init --runtime claude   # or: codex | antigravity | all
```

Node 20 or later. The kernel does not call a model and does not need an API key. Your own agent CLI writes the implementation.

## Six daily verbs

- `/ui:generate`: start from a plain-language brief.
- `/ui:learn`: learn from a live URL or an existing surface.
- `/ui:iterate` and `/ui:refine`: tighten a draft against the gates.
- `/ui:from-url`: start from a URL.
- `/ui:to-figma`: optional hand that authors idiomatic Figma on the canvas (auto-layout, instances, token-bound variables).
- `/ui:why`: explain a gate result.

## Core capabilities

- Command surface also includes `/ui:draft`, `/ui:spec`, `/ui:gate`, `/ui:render`, `/ui:inspect`.
- Deterministic taste gates: layout, contrast, accessibility, typography ladders, and token compliance.
- Cross-platform output: HTML/CSS/Tailwind for web, Figma Desktop via the optional local bridge, and native SwiftUI (native arms marked provisional where live accessibility and device coverage are still being proven).

## FAQ

- The kernel does not call a model or need an API key.
- It works with Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity through plain-language `/ui:*` commands installed by `ui init --runtime <name>`.
- Output: production HTML for web surfaces, idiomatic Figma through the opt-in Figma hand, and SwiftUI-first native macOS, iOS and iPadOS routes marked provisional.
- The Figma plugin and local canvas bridge live in a separate repository, design-os-figma-plugin.
